title: tephrosia mohrii
intro: Tephrosia mohrii, commonly known as the 'Black bean tree' or 'Mohrii', is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia mohrii are attributed to its ability to reduce oxidative stress, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of Tephrosia mohrii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
